newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks surge to close at new 1997 high.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks surge to close at new 1997 high.

text.p: Tokyo stocks surged on Friday to close at a new high for 1997, lifted by institutional investors, mostly pension funds, seeking blue-chip issues, brokers said.
The 225-share Nikkei average rose 239.42 points or 1.24 percent to end at 19,514.75, jumping above the previous closing high for 1997 of 19,446.00 set on January 6, the first trading day of year.
The last time the benchmark index closed above the 19,500 hurdle was on Christmas day, when it ended at 19,549.41.
